# SMART Sniffer App (HAOS Add-on)

> SMART Sniffer App is a Home Assistant OS add-on that monitors the health of the local
> HAOS boot drive -- the SSD or NVMe that Home Assistant OS runs on. It runs a
> lightweight S.M.A.R.T. agent inside the HA supervisor and exposes drive health data
> to the SMART Sniffer HACS integration as native HA entities. Requires the SMART
> Sniffer integration to be installed separately via HACS.

This add-on handles one specific use case: the drive inside the Home Assistant OS
machine itself. It is not for monitoring remote machines.

Key behaviors:
- Reads S.M.A.R.T. data from the HAOS host drive via smartctl inside the HA container.
  Requires SYS_RAWIO capability, which is configured automatically by the add-on.
- Exposes drive data via HTTP at 172.30.33.1:9099 by default.
- Advertises itself via mDNS so the SMART Sniffer integration can auto-discover it.
- Includes a Test Lab with simulated drives for safely testing the integration without
  real hardware. Mock drives are configurable via the built-in web UI.
- The web UI (Agent Control Center) is accessible from the HA add-on sidebar.

Configuration options:
- Agent Port (default: 9099)
- Bearer Token (optional, must match what is configured in the integration)
- Scan Interval in seconds (default: 60)
- Enable Mock Test Drives (off by default)
- Mock Agent Port (default: 9100)

What this add-on is NOT:
- Not for monitoring remote machines -- use the standalone Go agent from smart-sniffer
  for NAS, Proxmox, workstations, Macs, and other machines.
- Not a standalone tool -- requires the SMART Sniffer HACS integration to function.
- Not available on HACS -- install by adding the repo URL to the HA add-on store.

## Repositories

- [smart-sniffer-app (this repo)](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app):
  Add-on source (smart_sniffer_agent/), configuration schema (repository.yaml),
  Test Lab, and web UI.
- [smart-sniffer](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer): Primary repo. HACS
  integration, standalone Go agent for remote machines, and all project documentation.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/README.md):
  Installation steps, configuration reference, Test Lab usage, troubleshooting guide.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  Release history for the add-on.

## Optional

- [SMART Sniffer llms.txt](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer/blob/main/llms.txt):
  Full project context: agent architecture, entity reference, Attention Needed
  classification logic, supported drive types, and design rationale.
